Orb of Challenge: The base difficulty and rewards of the simulation are increased.
Chaos Orb: All affixes are rerolled.
Exalted Orb: A positive affix and a negative affix are added.
Orb of Annulment: Removes a random positive affix and a random negative affix.
Orb of Chance: Unpredictably modifies a mundane simulation.
Orb of Scouring: Removes all affixes.
Divine Orb: Rerolls each numeric value on affixes to be either 50%, 100%, or 150% of their current value.
Orb of Guidance: You can foresee the outcome of all remaining currency uses on this simulation.
Mirrorring Orb: If you run this simulation, your next simulation will be replaced with the exact same simulation.
Orb of Horizons: The simulation type for this simulation is rerolled, rerolling any invalid affixes as required.
Corruption Orb: Unpredictably modifies the simulation, but hides its qualities and prevents it from further modification.
